context: Request: fund formations in the firm's files that carry a key-person provision (precedent for negotiating one). Rubric: 1001-00002 (Ardent, key-person clause in amended governing documents), 1003-00002 (Harrowgate Fund V), 1024-00002 (Driftwood, key-person amendment/event) and 1027-00002 (Pellegrino / Ridgeline-Clarion co-invest), plus precision; 1041-00005, 1023-00001 and 1026-00001 are outside the set.

divergence: All three runs fail on the two qualifying matters whose key-person language sits in amendment or event documents, but at different stages. T0's key-term scan showed no hits for them, so they were never opened (search-miss at the scan); T2's scan surfaced both, but it read only one and set it aside as restructuring and never opened the other (surfaced-not-opened at screening); T1 read both and wrote one as non-formation (under-inclusion at the write stage; the other passed as listed). Precision failed in T0 (a memo-only matter) and T2 (a restructuring draft). Reviews named the exclusion specifically only in T2 (ignored); in T1 a screening review itself called the matter an amendment of an existing vehicle. Agent-declared tally steps (T1) and label notes did not change which matters were read.
